risks.note: Copper, aluminium, steel, PVC, insulation and sheathing compounds may be disrupted by geopolitical or unforeseen events, and their prices are affected by global commodity markets, exchange-rate movements, energy and freight costs, and trade restrictions; volatility can affect margins, working capital, order profitability and delivery schedules, particularly where customer-price revisions are unavailable or delayed.

Liquidity risk arises from the possibility the Company may be unable to meet financial obligations as they fall due; working-capital needs are affected by order execution, procurement, inventory, receivable collection and customer-payment delays, and credit risk arises if customers delay or fail to fulfil payment obligations.

The wires and cables industry is competitive, influenced by raw-material prices, demand conditions, capacity additions, customer concentration, product quality and pricing discipline; new entrants, excess capacity, aggressive pricing or shifting customer preferences may affect market position and margins.

The business requires skilled personnel across manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, supply chain, sales and finance; inability to attract, retain or develop qualified employees may affect operational efficiency, quality, customer service and growth plans.
risks.risk: Human resources, health and safety risk

risks.note: A portion of business is linked to project schedules, customer approvals, technical specifications, delivery milestones and payment terms; delays in execution, changes in customer requirements, deferment/cancellation of orders, delayed approvals or deteriorating customer creditworthiness may affect revenue, margins and cash flows.

Products serve industrial/infrastructure applications where quality, reliability and conformance to specifications matter; product-quality failures, process disruptions, equipment breakdowns, utility interruptions, fire, accidents or supply delays could affect production, delivery, customer relationships and financial performance.

Geopolitical events, trade restrictions, tariffs, sanctions, shipping disruptions, energy-price movements and global supply-chain constraints may affect availability, lead time and cost of raw materials and inputs, and may influence export demand and competitiveness in international markets.
risks.risk: Geopolitical, tariff and trade policy, and supply-chain risk
